@@ -804,0 +804,15 @@ + /** + * Returns the range of visible items in an indexed control. + *
    + *
  • Used by: ListView and TableView
    • + *
  • Needs notify: no
    • + *
  • Return Type: {@code int[]} containing the first item index and the + * number of visible items. If no items are fully visible the return + value should be {0, 0}
    • + *
  • Parameters:
    • + *
+ * + * @since 28 + */ + VISIBLE_ITEM_RANGE(int[].class), +
